name: Erik Marquardt - § 81 - Am 32
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the budget of the European Union Agencies for the financial year 2023
part_text: 81. Notes FRA's contribution to the evaluation of the European Border and Coast Guard Regulation (‘the EBCG Regulation’), participation in European Border Coast Agency (Frontex) management board meetings and co-chairing the Frontex Consultative Forum on Fundamental Rights and cooperation with the Fundamental Rights Office at Frontex;
